text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the day of the Shuka Sho drawing near,
Line Craft was—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mmh... mmmh...!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew!!
That's five sets done...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! I'm not tired.
I'm full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: "What's the next menu, Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, she approached her training
with exceptionally high motivation.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I can still remember it vividly, you know.
Going to watch last year's Shuka Sho together!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
That run where Sweep-san swept practically every Umamusume aside
and seized the victory...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
After yearning, and yearning... and beyond all that.
I am finally going to run in the Shuka Sho, too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
My drive to give it my all is limitless!
I can still keep going, you know~!!
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's keep the momentum going!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Alright!
Warm-ups are all done!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Today's a day off, so Trainer isn't here.
But the Shuka Sho is right around the corner!
I can't just sit around resting!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Solo training, solo training!
Heading out for perimeter laps!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu*...!
We've climbed up pretty high~...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? ...Ah!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-saaan!
You came out for a run too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! ...Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. The Shuka Sho is right around the corner!
There's no way we can just sit still!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Messiah, are you feeling a bit tired?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this mountain is pretty high, after all.
I think I'm starting to get a bit pooped too~...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right!
Once our break is over, wanna race a little?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Or maybe it's less a change of pace and more about getting pumped! The Umamusume-only lane just goes on and on, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Race you to the top!
What do you say, Messiah-san?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Racing... against Craft...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. I shall accept.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, ready?
On your marks—"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: The start!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhhhhh---!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Nnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*Haa, fuu, haa*!
*Fuuu*...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Hah... huff... hah, hah...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: *cough*, *hack*...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? M-Messiah-san!!
Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
*cough*... I'm all right.
I'm sorry for startling you...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not true...!
I didn't do anything... It's all thanks to Messiah-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Are you really okay...?
Because during the race just now—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...You're right.
I eased up on the pace midway through.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I feel like... I could never possibly catch up to you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...You've grown so strong, Craft-san.
It feels surreal that I managed to cross the line before you during our training run last year.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You are...
truly. ...Truly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: You have become... so strong...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Messiah-san!
Do you still have some time?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Since we climbed all the way up here,
why don't we bask in the sun for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Huh... Sunbathing, you say?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Look, the weather is suuuuper nice too!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Right?
Let's go under the shade of that tree over there. Just for a bit!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle rustle rustle rustle rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: *Yaaawn*... That feels so nice, Messiah-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Craft-san—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...You know, Messiah-san, I...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: It was my "admiration" that brought me this far.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to that 'admiration,' I was able to become strong.
...And run all the way to this point."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! ...'Admiration'...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! My admiration for the Tiara Umamusume.
Ramonu-san, Air Groove-san, Sweep-san...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: And on top of that... my admiration for you and your mother!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san, do you remember?
I ended up crying!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"When we ended up in the same class and got to talk for the first time,
I was just so, so happy!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Because I've always truly admired it! The incredible strength of your mother who conquered the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Carrying on those feelings and teachings, connecting them, and starting to run... that goes for you, too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Am I getting stronger? Then that's thanks to Messiah-san and the others too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Because just like your mother,
I want to carry on those wonderful feelings.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
To you, who runs carrying those feelings—
to you, a strong Tiara Umamusume,
because I want to defeat you!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah-san...
...The Umamusume I look up to.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"At the Shuka Sho.
Will you compete against me with everything you've got?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...The hell, you're actually coming today?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
!?
Huh... Shakur-san?!
Air Groove-senpai, too...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Were you waiting for me?
For... me...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...You take after your mother a lot—
sincere, serious, and a hard worker.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There is no doubt in my mind about returning to the place of hard work like this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I'm different. Don't lump me in with them.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It just means half-assed data
isn't good for anything.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Both of you...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Excuse me. Thank you very much.
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
We ain't got time for crying.
If you're gonna do it, hurry up and get going!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Don't waste even a tenth of a second until the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Hk, yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the few days remaining until the Shuka Sho
flew by in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And with that, the time had finally come.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Pheeew...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'm off.
I'll claim the final crown!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Hi, Craft!
Fufufu, look at that determined face.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Victory will be mine!
—Something with that kind of spirit?"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
*flinch*... Um, yeah!
I came here to win.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I see. ...Even if I say "I won't forgive you"?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Even if it's forbidden, I'm going after it!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...No, I will.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: The autumn Tiara shall be mine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, my.
Huhâ"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
The look in your eyes has changed, hasn't it?
...It's hard to believe how clouded they were back around summer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. Because I was able to re-examine what I truly ought to believe in.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: For a while... I doubted. But I managed to remember.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My pride. My confidence. My pillar of support.
The very thing that fires me up more than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Be diligent. Be steadfast.
Even if you don't possess exceptional genius—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I am strong. Unquestionably strong.
...Just as I believe in and revere my mother, so too shall I believe in myself!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...You were the one who reminded me.
Craft-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Messiah-san...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
If you'll have it...
Please allow me to give you my answer to your offer from back then, right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
—I accept your challenge, Craft-san.
At this very Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Let us compete with everything we've got.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I won't lose, Messiah-san!!
